scope: Empirical screen on isolated-rotor data at selected profiles’ fixed controls, with no re-search. It marks an unresolved state, not measured instability of an unbuilt hull; it does not make quasi-static closure false. Power while rising is priced as level flight with no bound. No replacement power, thrust or efficiency penalty is assigned.

inputs.scope: Stipulated sensitivity inputs from the reviewer’s isolated-rotor screen; not measured hull or coaxial-array properties.

method: Equal midpoint progress samples per phase, matching the pre-review probe. Hover induced velocity uses actual rotor thrust and local density; normalized axial speed is signed hull velocity relative to downward thrust, and normalized edgewise speed is the model’s airV. Footprint changes normalization on the same original trace only.
